author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Is buying pieces and styling them a valid way of cosplaying? How does Adam acquire quality items online in a world where good reviews don't always match reality? In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers these questions from Tested members tommcd5146 and xPir8x, whom we thank for their support! Do you agree with Adam's distinction between cosplay and costumes?
